svg.text: SWAGameMobModel: one mesh per species, posed by four angles in the vertex shader
Side view from the left, 1 square = 1 model pixel (1/16 block before pixelScale 0.6). Colour = limb code (vertex alpha / 32), ring = pivot (texcoords). Far-side legs are darker.
phase π/2, swing 0.9: front legs -0.90 rad, hind +1.17 rad
Feet leave the ground while the legs are stretched (sin phase > 0).
isEating: head 0.5 + 0.08 sin(14 s) rad, legs still
Each animal’s clock is offset by identityHash \\ 97 / 9 s,
so a grazing herd does not nibble in step.
four separate legs, one group each; A and B are the diagonal pairs
phase π/2, swing 0.6: legs A +0.60 rad, legs B -0.60 rad
A positive angle swings the foot backwards. Front left and hind right (A) push back while
front right and hind left (B) reach forward; half a stride later they swap.
Body (0) is never moved by the shader.
